title: Export site as ZIP from the '…' menu lands on the ZIP flow of the Publish tab (the dialog is gone): through My Sites' real menu action, once, and the ZIP step runs Prepare, Send code and Download; the backup download dialog focuses itself on dsh's React 18
steps: S1: With the real My Sites row menu and its action (site-actions.ts), choose Export site as ZIP for an Owner's site.
S2: Then choose Publish for another site, and again Export site as ZIP followed by the tab header's site picker to another site.
S3: On the ZIP step press Prepare ZIP, then Send code; type five digits, then six; press Download.
S4: On React 18, open the Backup download dialog and read the focused element.
expect: S1: the side card opens tracy:site-publish with meta { siteKey, publishEntry: 'zip' }, and the wizard shows data-publish-kind="zip" on data-publish-step="zip".
S2: the other site's wizard starts on data-publish-step="kind" both times, never on the ZIP flow again.
S3: the stage goes confirm, ready, code; Download stays disabled with five digits and is enabled with six; then downloaded.
S4: the dialog itself holds focus.

selectors.tool: node --test browser test of the Publish tab with the real My Sites menu, the ZIP step DOM test (jsdom), and the backup download dialog test bundled on dsh's React 18

evidence: Measured on dev 17/10/2026 after #1421: the dialog was 1248px wide at 1280 (later sheets' `.max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)]` beat My Sites' `sm:max-w-lg`), and Base UI focused the Export details trigger 18ms after the menu click: dsh runs React 18.3.1, which drops the `ref` given to tracy-ui's DialogContent, so `initialFocus={ref}` resolved to null and fell back to the first tabbable control. The local tests had passed on React 19 with one stylesheet.
fence: Browser fixture with the plugin's real apply() and My Sites' real menu action, API doors stubbed; the ZIP step in jsdom with the export doors stubbed; English only. The 512px dialog width and its focus on the dsh page have no counterpart since Export became a step of the Publish tab (23/10/2026)

tests: "Export site as ZIP" lands on the ZIP flow once; Publish of another site and the site picker start at the choice
ZIP: Prepare, Send code, then Download only once six digits are typed, and Downloaded
opening the backup download dialog focuses the dialog, not its first button
